card.statement:
The following commutation relations hold between the generators of $U_{\mathbb A}$. For $k\in\mathbb Z$, $l\in\mathbb Z_{> 0}$, $1\leq i,j\leq N$,

\begin{align*}
x_{ik}^+ \Lnum{K_j}{s}{n} & = \Lnum{K_j}{s-a_{ji}}{n}x_{ik}^+, \\
x_{ik}^+ \Lnum{D}{s}{n} &= \Lnum{D}{s-k}{n}x_{ik}^+, \\
\Lnum{K_j}{s}{n}x_{ik}^- &= x_{ik}^- \Lnum{K_j}{s-a_{ji}}{n}, \\
\Lnum{D}{s}{n}x_{ik}^- &= x_{ik}^- \Lnum{D}{s-k}{n},\\
\Lnum{D}{s}{n}h_{ik} &= h_{ik} \Lnum{D}{s+k}{n},\\
[\gamma^{\pm 1/2},U_{\mathbb A} ]&=[D,K_i^{\pm 1}]=[K_i,K_j]=[K_i,h_{jk}]=0, \\
Dh_{ir} &=q^rh_{ir}D,\quad Dx_{ir}^{\pm} =q^rx_{ir}^{\pm}D,\\
K_ix_{jr}^{\pm} &= q_i^{\pm  (\alpha_i|\alpha_j)}x_{jr}^{\pm}K_i,   \\
[h_{ik},h_{jl}]&=\delta_{k,-l} \frac{1}{k}[ka_{ij}]_i\Lnum{\gamma}{k}{1}_i \\
[h_{ik},x^{\pm}_{jl}]&= \pm \frac{1}{k}[ka_{ij}]_i\gamma^{\mp |k|/2}x^{\pm}_{j,k+l},  \\
[x^+_{ik},x^-_{jl}]&=\delta_{ij}
\Lnum{\gamma\psi_i}{k,l}{1}.
\end{align*}
card.label: Proposition 7

paper.title: An imaginary PBW basis for quantum affine algebras of type 1
paper.abstract: Let $\hat{\mathfrak g}$ be an affine Lie algebra of type 1. We give a PBW basis for the quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak g})$ with respect to the triangular decomposition of $\hat{\mathfrak g}$ associated with the imaginary positive root system.
